Each reason is the rail's sentence for that reason name. A row opens the message in its label list.
Scores run from 0 to 1. The deployment default is 0.40 and 0.85.
With these values, Remit warns about 51 and moves 131 of the mail it checked in the last 30 days.
These values apply to mail arriving from now on.
Check again in any list updates older mail.
Warn only keeps the message where it arrived, under the warning banner.
